Job Position – General Accountant

Company Name – Al Mulla Group

Location: Dubai, UAE

Job Type: Full-time

Availability: Immediate joiners preferred

Job Summary:
Urgently looking for a qualified and experienced General Accountant with UAE real estate experience to join the team.

Key Responsibilities:
– Maintain accurate financial records and general ledger entries
-Monitor project costs, budgets, and prepare financial statements
– Handle accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and payroll
– Prepare and file VAT returns in compliance with UAE regulations
– Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes
– Coordinate with external auditors and support audit requirements
– Assist in financial forecasting, budgeting, and cash flow management
– Collaborate with internal teams to ensure financial alignment with project goals

Requirements:
– Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
– 2–3 years of experience as a General Accountant in the UAE real estate industry.
– Good knowledge of UAE VAT regulations and tax compliance.
– Experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.
– Proficiency in accounting software such as Tally, QuickBooks, or similar.
– Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
– Good attention to detail and organizational skills.
– Candidates with immediate availability will be preferred.
